headline: Saturday in Branson: Cloudy with Rain Chances & Halloween Trick-or-Treat
lede: Saturday, October 31 brings highs near 72°F under mostly cloudy skies with a chance of showers — classic fall weather for first-timers to enjoy indoor shows, safe trick-or-treating at Branson Landing, and relaxed lake time.
